services.name: Venue Rentals
services.desc: Winner of the 2025 Pulitzer Prize and a smash hit on Broadway, Purpose is the explosive and wildly entertaining new play from Tony winner Branden Jacobs-Jenkins, diving headlong into the life of a prominent and influential political dynasty. Harper Lee’s enduring classic To Kill a Mockingbird is adapted anew as Aaron Sorkin, the brilliant and beautifully idealistic creator of The West Wing and A Few Good Men, returns to writing for the stage. Map out your route to The Huntington Theatre on Huntington Ave. and The Calderwood Pavilion on Tremont St. The Huntington is committed to making the arts accessible to all.
